So retrosynthesis: break sulfonamide to give sulfonyl chloride and aromatic amine. So first disconnection: target -> sulfonyl chloride (phenylsulfonyl chloride?) Actually target has sulfonyl attached to aromatic ring (phenyl) and also attached to another aromatic ring? Let's parse: O=S(NC1=...)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O. So sulfonyl attached to an aniline (NC1...) and to a fluorophenyl (C5...). So sulfonamide formed from sulfonyl chloride reacting with aromatic amine. So retrosynthetic step: break S-N bond to give sulfonyl chloride (Ar-SO2-Cl) and aromatic amine (the NC1...). So we need template for sulfonamide formation (S-Cl broken, S-N formed). We need to find template ID. Use search with functional_groups_formed: sulfonamides, broken: halide. Already attempted but got empty.
